nodes.name: Start
nodes.notes: in: — → out: — · start a run (swap for a Webhook or Schedule trigger)

assignments.name: task
assignments.value: Verify Base block 51828000 under the SuperRoot and return the portable V5 proof (class proof.verify.v5).

nodes.name: Inputs
nodes.notes: in: — → out: hire.json · the hire intent: task, candidate seller, endpoint/tool, buyer, price, chain (a HIRE in state Open)

nodes.name: Offer + deliver
nodes.notes: in: hire.json → out: job.json · POST /v1/handshake {dispatch:true}: the offer goes to the seller’s own endpoint; the reply is held with its keccak digest

nodes.name: Delivery
nodes.notes: in: job.json → out: delivery.json · stop unless a reply digest is held (no digest = nothing to settle)

nodes.name: Judge · prepare
nodes.notes: in: delivery.json → out: facts.json · POST /v1/judge/compose (prepare): the facts decide first; hard_fail ends here; else the exact text Jev reads + prepare_digest

nodes.name: Hard fail?
nodes.notes: in: facts.json → out: facts.json · branch: a hard fail goes straight to the verdict without asking Jev

nodes.name: Jev · TypeSafe (our credential)
nodes.notes: in: facts.json → out: answers.json · TypeSafe ask on the prepared text: every RUBRIC_ASKED answer with its whole distribution

nodes.name: Judge · answers
nodes.notes: in: answers.json → out: verdict.json · POST /v1/judge/compose (answers): recompose under THRESHOLDS_v1, record decision.v2, anchor on JevDecisionLog

nodes.name: Verdict
nodes.notes: in: verdict.json | facts.json → out: verdict.json · the composed verdict (complete | reject | needs_review) with what settlement needs carried forward

nodes.name: Settle
nodes.notes: in: verdict.json → out: settlement.json · POST /v1/settle: the plan (jobId, price, premium, deposit, calls[] in order, who signs each)

nodes.name: Seller · approve deposit
nodes.notes: in: settlement.json → out: settlement.json · the seller approves D (> P); the tx joins settlement.txs

nodes.name: Buyer · approve + fund
nodes.notes: in: settlement.json → out: settlement.json · the buyer approves P + π and calls fundJob: machine Delivered → Funded

nodes.name: Seller · submit
nodes.notes: in: settlement.json → out: settlement.json · submit(jobId, evidenceDigest = delivery.digest): machine Funded → Submitted

nodes.name: Buyer · complete + capture
nodes.notes: in: settlement.json → out: settlement.json · complete(jobId) (+ capture): machine → Settled

nodes.name: Receipt
nodes.notes: in: settlement.json → out: job.json · the whole JOB: hire, delivery, facts, verdict, settlement — every transaction with its proof link

nodes.name: Verdict says complete?
nodes.notes: in: settlement.json → out: settlement.json · branch on the composed verdict: complete → complete; otherwise hold (Submitted → Held)

nodes.name: Held for review
nodes.notes: in: settlement.json → out: settlement.json · needs_review / reject: funded and sealed, nothing paid; the evaluator leg or the deadline decides
